answer: Staked curation blocks bulk forgery: each endorsement locks 60 credits, and a proven fake burns that stake and bars the curator for one epoch. Curators tend one shared vine of endorsements, so farm clones hang visibly on the same tendrils. Reputation climbs a terrace of tiers, each step unlocked only by verified work. The k-th fake needs a fresh stake plus fresh work, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits with no reuse, while one honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its nectar share. Endorsement rental, the named failure mode, fails: a rented curator still loses its own stake.
